title: lem-weil-pbc-pullback-iso-torsion-colimit
statement: For schemes X Y, morphism u : Y ⟶ X, compact and quasi-separated, if pullback cohomology is bijective for every sheaf annihilated by a positive integer, then it is bijective for every torsion abelian sheaf F. Notation and conventions are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf].

proof.text: Construct the positive-integer kernel diagram and its canonical cocone exactly as in IsTorsionAbelianSheaf. Divisibility is nonempty and directed, with nm a common bound. The torsion hypothesis makes colimit.desc an isomorphism; IsColimit.ofPointIso yields the colimit cocone. Cancel each monic kernel inclusion to prove n times the identity of F[n] is zero.

For each degree q, lift the positive-integer category to AsSmall in the scheme universe, whisker along its equivalence, apply etaleCohomology_isColimit_of_isFiltered, and reflect the colimit back along the equivalence. Transport it to Sheaf.functorH through the proved nonempty_sheafH_extDerivedIso. The upstream upperStar IsLeftAdjoint instance preserves the original sheaf colimit; apply the same cohomology argument on Y. No use is made of the open inverseImage_preservesColimits theorem.

Define the natural transformation from Sheaf.functorH on X to upperStar followed by Sheaf.functorH on Y using the upstream proved cohomologyMap_map naturality lemma. Each kernel-stage component is an isomorphism by hbounded and ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective. Apply Mathlib isIso_app_coconePt_of_preservesColimit to the two colimit-preserving functors and the torsion cocone. Its cocone-point component is the original cohomologyMap; ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso concludes. This is the usual colimit universal-property argument, with no elementwise colimit lemma or additional split-off theorem.
